item.title: viebBook 2.6.9
item.description:
Drawings now stay within their background frame when drawing or moving shapes. Previews use the saved canvas proportions without the extra bottom strip. The drawing canvas and preview follow the book page theme, while stored artwork stays unchanged. Publisher QR codes in book content are smaller; QR invoices retain their size.
Mac 2.6.9. Thirteen targeted document and real WebKit drawing tests passed.
SHA-256: `b4c2d6604b1fe294199ef4e6499f41d02356f059b860b3ad3c2f46b0354a26c4`

item.title: viebBook 2.6.8
item.description:
The pairing sheet has a cleaner fixed layout with aligned network, address and code details and copy controls. The whole Weitere Optionen row now toggles instantly. QR pixels stay cached when options or hover state change, and generation runs off the main actor. Small windows keep scrolling and content padding.
QR payload, error correction and quiet zone are unchanged. Close or Escape cancels pairing. Mac release 2.6.8. Forty pairing/security tests and two native QR/presentation tests passed, including full-row clicks, fixed dimensions, rendered QR decoding, light/dark layouts and short-window scrolling.

item.title: viebBook 2.6.7
item.description:
Settings use shorter labels and clarify that viebBook must remain open on the Mac during sync. Newly paired devices show a concise pending-sync status.
Includes the 2.6.6 AI panel fix: login status and model lists stay cached across Settings and chat-panel visits, concurrent lookups are shared, and failed refreshes keep the last good result. Prüfen explicitly refreshes the connection.
Release publishing now authenticates GitHub metadata requests to avoid anonymous shared-runner rate limits. Mac 2.6.7, build 362. Six focused AI cache and sync-copy tests passed.

item.title: viebBook 2.6.6
item.description:
AI settings and chat panels now share cached login status and model lists. Reopening a panel keeps the saved provider and model visible. Leaving a view no longer discards a lookup or starts another model request. Failed refreshes retain the last good result; Prüfen explicitly refreshes it. Model-picker loading no longer rewrites settings.
Mac release 2.6.6. Seven focused cache and settings-persistence tests passed.

item.title: viebBook 2.6.5
item.description:
Mac 2.6.5 polishes sidebar dragging, Search and device pairing.
- The dragged book replaces its original row, stays aligned to the sidebar, and glides into its destination on release. The insertion line and freely moving pointer are retained. - Haptic profiles use one native tap instead of repeated pulse bursts. Rapid boundary jitter is filtered out. - Search sits below a plain title bar with aligned controls and cleaner surfaces. Volltext/Titel can be selected before typing and the selection survives page changes. Long result titles stay bounded with full-title tooltips. - The pairing sheet has fixed header/footer areas and a scrolling body, preserving padding when extra options expand. QR paper and its quiet zone use one mild off-white shade with sharp black modules. Helper copy is shorter.
Includes signed Sparkle updates from the public downloads repository, cached AI readiness/model information, compact chat input with Shift-Enter newlines, clearer advanced settings inputs and the taller sidebar arrangement sheet.
Validation: seven native drag, single-tap haptic and search tests passed; three QR tests passed, including decoding and uniform, unblurred paper/module checks. Dark and light Search/Settings fixtures were inspected. Release app and Sparkle framework signatures were verified.
Apple silicon, macOS 14 or newer. LAN sync requires macOS 15. Ad-hoc signed: use right-click → Open on first installation if macOS asks. Older builds with the private update URL require one manual installation.
